title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Before arriving, we had heard rave reviews about the pandebono (Colombian cheese bread) and it did not disappoint! Makes for an easy breakfast to get you ready for the day.

Our go-to for lunch was the bandeja paisa (literally translates to country meal), a delicious and balanced platter of meats, rice, beans, and more. El Pilón Guarceño was our favourite spot for bandeja paise in Medellin. Mondongo’s is very popular (and good) too!
In coastal Cartagena, we enjoyed the fish sancocho at Coroncoro.
